name: octodns-258814ad-blind20-ots
instr:
# octoDNS: repairing twenty behaviour regressions without a test suite

I keep our zones as files in git and push them out to hosted services with this tool, and since an upgrade a great deal of everyday behaviour is wrong. Nothing about our configuration changed and nothing about the hosted services changed. The repository has received 20 separate undocumented edits. What follows is what I can reproduce, grouped by what I was doing at the time.

Writing a zone down and reading it back. Mixed case is no longer folded away anywhere a name is settled on: an entry created as `MiXeDcAsE` keeps its capitals, a zone created as `UniT.TEsTs.` keeps its capitals, and hostname-valued entries written in upper case — CNAME, DNAME, PTR, MX and the apex-only kind — no longer compare equal to the same value in lower case, so the marker entries noting which names this tool owns come out with the wrong case, and the same zone configured twice, once in unicode and once in its ASCII-compatible encoded form, is no longer noticed as a duplicate. Going the other way, an ASCII-compatible encoded name written in upper case comes back as an upper-case unicode result rather than a lower-case one. Values holding a single hostname substitute placeholders backwards: one written with a placeholder comes back untouched, so the placeholder survives into the final hostname; a placeholder nobody defined no longer produces the undefined-parameter error; and one with no placeholder at all, which used to be hand
